title: English Practice Quiz 0122
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.
questions.explanation: After doesn't, use the base form of the verb: like.

questions.question: Water ___ at 100°C at sea level.
questions.explanation: Use the present simple for general facts.

questions.question: Choose the correct word: Please ___ the details.
questions.explanation: Confirm means to check or establish that something is correct.

questions.question: We have a meeting ___ Monday.
questions.explanation: Use on with days and dates.

questions.question: Choose the correct plural of 'child'.
questions.explanation: Children is the irregular plural of child.

questions.question: How many syllables are in 'computer'?
questions.explanation: Computer is commonly pronounced with three syllables: com-pu-ter.

questions.question: Choose the correct WH question for a place.
questions.explanation: Where asks about a place or location.

questions.question: The weather can ___ your travel plans.
questions.explanation: Affect is usually a verb meaning to influence.

questions.question: The work ___ tomorrow.
questions.explanation: Future passive uses will be + past participle.

questions.question: There is ___ water in the bottle.
questions.explanation: A little is used with uncountable nouns.
